job.title: Systems Engineer - Network Data Plane Software
job.pay_full: $168,000 – $210,000 estimated annual salary for Champaign, IL based hires ($185,000 – $230,000 for Washington, DC or Seattle, WA), plus equity

details.about: Cloudflare runs one of the world's largest networks on general-purpose Linux servers, so the routers, firewalls, load balancers and proxies that carry its customers' traffic are software it writes and operates itself. The Packet Processing team builds that software, the engines behind products like Magic Transit, Cloudflare WAN, Cloudflare Network Firewall and Spectrum, and is moving to one unified data plane that all its L3/L4 products share.
duties: Build the shared data plane platform: packet I/O, processing stages, per-core steering, per-customer isolation and upgrades that don't drop traffic
Work on a userspace forwarding plane with per-customer routing over GRE and IPsec tunnels and direct connections
Develop a stateful packet firewall in Rust: rule evaluation, rate limiting, intrusion detection, packet capture, IPv4/IPv6
Work on an XDP-based L4 load balancer and an XDP/eBPF fast path for very large single flows
Improve host networking so each packet is classified once
Chase down packet drops, latency and throughput problems across servers in hundreds of cities
Build, deploy and operate these systems, mostly in Go and Rust (plus C for eBPF) on Linux
needs: Systems programming in Rust, Go, C or C++
Solid understanding of L3/L4 networking: IP, TCP, UDP, routing and forwarding, GRE/IPsec tunneling, NAT, connection tracking and anycast
Experience building data plane software such as routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, VPN gateways or SDN/NFV systems
Linux networking: eBPF/XDP, tc, netfilter/nftables, network namespaces, sockets
High-performance packet processing in user space or the kernel (e.g. AF_XDP, DPDK, VPP)
Debugging, profiling and optimizing throughput- and latency-sensitive systems
Building and operating large-scale distributed systems, including on-call, incident response and root cause analysis
nice: Router, switch or network OS development
Network firewalls, IDS/IPS (e.g. Suricata, Snort) or rate limiting
L4 load balancing (e.g. Maglev-style consistent hashing, Katran, IPVS)
Running large networks: ISPs, data center networks or backbone operations
Open-source networking contributions (e.g. Linux kernel, DPDK, VPP, FRR)
details.benefits: Estimated annual salary $168,000 – $210,000 for Champaign, IL based hires, and $185,000 – $230,000 for Washington, DC or Seattle, WA based hires; pay may be adjusted by work location. The role is eligible for Cloudflare's equity plan. US benefits include medical/Rx, dental and vision insurance, flexible and commuter spending accounts, fertility and family-forming benefits, on-demand mental health support and an EAP, global travel medical insurance, short- and long-term disability, life and accident insurance, a 401(k), an Employee Stock Participation Plan, flexible paid time off, and parental, pregnancy health, medical and bereavement leave.
notes: Listed locations include Austin TX, Champaign IL, Atlanta GA and Washington DC (plus Lisbon and London)
Applicants who reach the offer stage may be asked to attend an in-person interview at a Cloudflare office or hub
Offers may be conditioned on authorization to receive technology controlled under US export laws without an export license sponsorship
